headline: Orchestration coordinates a run. Ateles organizes ongoing responsibility.
lede: Both can route work. The difference appears when roles, priorities, authority, and accountability must persist beyond one execution.
rows: A router selects or spawns a worker
Named roles take responsibility within a standing organization
Context is supplied to the current run
The task carries a line back to the mission and priorities above it
The workflow reaches a configured step
A consequential action returns to the person entitled to decide
Roles, relationships, responsibilities, decisions, and accountable outcomes
